text:
Ops-bot: INCIDENT - p99 latency spike on service generation:cont-batch (usw2). p95 ~850ms, p99 ~2.4s, streaming stalls increasing. Paging eng-oncall :rotating_light:
Maya: Oncall Maya taking initial triage. Looking at dashboards now. @Tony FYI I'll start mitigation, can you take follow-up handoff in 10m?
Lin: I see KV eviction churn and packer queue depth ballooning. Many short requests mixing with a few very long seqs -> pack size blowout.
Alex: Noted. Quick mitigation idea: cap pack max_tokens and enable preemptive streaming so short requests aren't stuck behind heavy packs.
Maya: Agreed. Plan: 1) set packer.max_batch_tokens=512 temporarily 2) enable CONTBATCH_PREEMPT=1 3) add temporary routing to model-small variant if p99 persists 4) notify customers if >1% errors.
Alex: I'll push a canary config to generation-packer-usw2-canary.
Alex: ```bash
curl -X POST https://infra-api.internal/configs/packer -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"region":"usw2","packer.max_batch_tokens":512,"env":{"CONTBATCH_PREEMPT":"1"}}'
```
Maya: Thanks. Also run a short KV eviction throttle: `kv.eviction_rate_limit=0.4` on canary.
Lin: Traces show the long tails are happening at the pack boundary where mixed seqlen causes serialization. Reducing max_batch_tokens should reduce both queueing and tail.
Deploy-bot: rollout started for generation-packer-usw2-canary - change id cfg-20260317-01.
Deploy-bot: rollout ok on canary (3/3). Starting gradual rollout to region (5m window).
Alex: Canary metrics: p99 down from 2.4s -> 1.7s, p95 -> 420ms. Streaming stall count dropped by ~60%.
Customer Success Bot: CS reported a small number of user timeouts on a high-traffic customer but no data loss. Customer notified proactively.
Maya: Good. Continue rollout but watch for packer CPU increase. If packer CPU spikes, revert and fallback-route to dedicated pool.
Tony: I'll take the handoff in 8m. If p99 remains >2s after full rollout, I'll open eng-sre escalation and trigger model-fallback routing.
Lin: FYI I deployed a temporary scheduling fairness tweak (reduce greedy_pack_weight from 1.0 -> 0.6) on the canary to avoid one-heavy-request hogging the next pack. That also seems to help.
Alex: Full region rollout complete. Deploy-bot: cfg-20260317-01 applied to generation-packer-usw2 (12/12).
Deploy-bot: observability note: post-change p99 = 1.15s, p95 = 380ms. Latency curves flattening.
Maya: Monitoring for 15m. Customer impact appears contained. Documenting actions in incident ticket #INC-2026-0317-02.
Tony: Taking over monitoring. I'll keep the channel updated every 5m. If anything regresses I'll escalate immediately.
Maya: Handing off to @Tony for ongoing monitoring and any further mitigation. Thanks everyone :heart:
Tony: Acknowledged. I'll leave a note on the incident ticket and follow up with CS after 30m for customer confirm.
Ops-bot: Incident cleared threshold. p99 < 1.3s for 10m. Closing pager but keeping ticket open for postmortem.
